accessibility.evidence: Fourteen route-level axe scans and independent scans inside the open mobile menu and film dialog. The film retains native playback and loop control, captions, keyboard focus restoration and stable reduced-motion chrome. Tested keyboard focus containment, forward and reverse tabbing, Escape and focus restoration when crossing the desktop breakpoint.

responsive.evidence: All fourteen routes at four widths. Five portfolio cards are reachable across desktop, phone and reduced-motion views. Mobile diptych and panorama retain the entire image. The exact hero crop, multiline typography and menu were compared at matching reference viewports.

loading.evidence: The case-film dialog loads the selected MP4 after activation; the cover photograph appears in its place on the case page before activation. Navigation and editorial content remain visible before motion setup.

empty.reason: The static archive contains five film or photographic works. No runtime search or empty query state applies.

error.evidence: Invalid form input receives field feedback and focus. Unknown project routes have an HTTP 404.

partial.evidence: Four photographic entries show image galleries or an image detail without a film player. Their titles, cover photographs and credits distinguish them from the studio film.

success.evidence: A valid inquiry renders an editable local preview and produces no outbound submission.

permission.reason: The marketing site and local inquiry preview require no account or permission dialog.

renderedEvidence.observation: At 360 px each line of the large title fits the viewport. The signature, menu, portrait and film action remain visible.
At 390 px the hero uses a portrait crop and an independent red italic final line. All five archive cards appear in reading order; paired portraits and panorama are uncropped on the detail pages.
The 768 px header keeps the inquiry action and dialog toggle. Four title lines overlay the camera portrait, and the film action remains visible.

The 1440 px hero matches the reference line breaks and upper typography position. Five separate photographs travel horizontally with five individual links; Tab and Shift+Tab bring each focused card fully into view.
